messages:
kevin: Heads up — GCP true-up landed for last week. Looks like A100 on-demand overage in us-west1. Committed: 250 A100 GPUs, hosted peak observed: 320, weekly avg: 295. Rough true-up estimate from billing export ~ $48k. Anyone tracking the demand spike?

maya: :eyes: pulling reservation vs runtime now, will slice by pool and route.

billing-bot: [ALERT] True-up invoice detected: $48,300 on-demand overage (region=us-west1, resource=A100). Billing export: https://billing.example/reports/2026-03-14/trueup-usw1

ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed scale events: hosted-usw-a100 scaled to 1.3x expected baseline at 2026-03-12T14:00Z — autoscaler triggered extra nodes.

maya: quick query I ran on usage DB shows concentrated spike during API campaign windows (promo-run routes). snippet:```sql
SELECT hour, SUM(gpu_hours) AS gpu_hours
FROM usage
WHERE region='us-west1' AND gpu_type='A100' AND ts >= '2026-03-08'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 48;
```

sasha: yep that matches product signal — we had increased traffic from the marketing campaign and a couple of big enterprise evals hitting streaming endpoints. Some sessions stuck open (long-tail).

liam: autoscaler logs look odd, saw ~20% of scale-up events failed to attach nodes due to cloud quota throttling, causing more on-demand instances to get spun by fallback. grabbing logs now.

kevin: quota throttle? that's new. can you paste the error lines?

liam: error sample: `InstanceAttachFailed: QuotaExceeded: requestedInstances (85) > availableQuota (65) in project redwood-prod-usw`. Happened in 3 scale ops windows.

maya: that explains spike — autoscaler kept retrying, fallback created different classes that incur on-demand pricing.

anya: product asked if we can throttle non-critical routes or downgrade GPU class to A10G for batch flows. short term routing might shave the peak.

kevin: mitigation proposals: 1) immediate: set hard rate-limits on promo-run and batch routes; 2) route non-streaming sessions to dedicated/reserved pool (we have spare Dedicated capacity in eu-west mapped to lower latency cost); 3) patch autoscaler to fail-fast to avoid runaway fallback; 4) long-term: true-up commit or buy flex credits.

maya: I can push rate-limits and route rules now. Proposed infractl change:```bash
infractl patch-route --route promo-run --qps 20 --fallback-route dedicated-usw-a100
infractl set-throttle --route batch-embedding --max-concurrent 30
```

liam: I'll open a support case with cloud for quota bump and also add a retry/backoff fix in autoscaler. Quick patch:```bash
infractl patch-autoscaler --pool hosted-usw-a100 --scale-min 40 --scale-max 220 --fail-fast true
```

sasha: product ok with temporary route changes for 48h, they'll message marketing. we'll coordinate cutoff windows.

kevin: Maya + Liam + Sasha — action owners. Can someone produce a cost delta if we: (A) route 20% of promo traffic to Dedicated for 48h, (B) buy incremental 30 GPU short-term commitment for 1 month. Need $ impact before EOD.

maya: I'll run the cost projection now and post numbers in ~3 hours.

liam: I'll attach autoscaler logs to the ticket and start quota case. ticket: CLOUD-5821.

anya: also consider lower-cost quantized variants for non-LLM-critical flows, e.g., 8-bit A100 or A10G with model quant. ops-R&D has a quick quant pipeline we can try.

kevin: Good. One more ask: billing folks, can you add a tag on the invoice lines linking on-demand charge to route-level tags so we can attribute to promo-run?

billing-bot: Requested tag injection into billing export: status queued. Will post updated export when available.

maya: interim summary and immediate next steps:
- Apply rate-limits and route fallback to Dedicated (maya) — in progress
- Autoscaler fail-fast and quota case (liam) — in progress, CLOUD-5821 open
- Product to notify marketing and throttle campaign windows (sasha) — ack
- Cost projection for routing vs short-term commit (maya) — deliver by EOD
- Billing tagging for invoice attribution (billing-bot) — queued

kevin: Thanks team. After we have projections, we'll decide on short-term 30 GPU commit vs routing. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

kevin: (meta) let's also add a postmortem-style note to compute-team about autoscaler behavior so we don't get surprised on future promos. Assigning to ops-playbook backlog.
